parakeet: How do we support growth without shame? How do we mark life's milestones without requiring supernatural beliefs? And how do we build meaningful lives without religion? Questioning what we've been taught is only part of the journey. Join us November 6th through the 8th. Humanism That Helps. 11 focused virtual sessions where we'll explore Christianity and the meaning crisis with Brittany Hartley of No Nonsense Spirituality. We'll discuss building loving people-centered communities with Joe Pittinger of West Hill United. Learn more about humanism through music and the social arts with Bridge City's very own director of social arts, Jude Bartlett. And we'll hear from former pastor Kyle Butler as he talks about the known human experience. Then hang out with Darante' Lamar Martin and other Bridge City leaders as they unpack what it means to move humanism beyond ideas and put it to work in the real world. Applied humanism is the practice. Humanism that helps is where the two come together. Join us virtually, November 6th through the 8th. Tickets are just $99. Learn more and register at DLDD.us help.
